steps.title: Prepare the surgical space and animal
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and anesthetize the mouse for surgery.

substeps.instruction: Place the absorbent pad and inhalatory anesthesia.
Record the mouse weight.
Induce anesthesia with 3% Isofluorane.
Place the animal in a supine position and maintain anesthesia at 1-1.5%.

steps.title: Prepare the incision area
steps.instruction: Clean and numb the left abdominal area to prepare for incision.

substeps.instruction: Apply eye lubricant (e.g., Lacri Lube).
Apply hair removal cream (e.g., Nair) to the left abdominal area.
Apply Povidone/Iodine to the incision area.
Apply Lidocaine.
Apply an Ethanol swab.

steps.title: Expose the pancreas
steps.instruction: Perform the incision and isolate the pancreas.

substeps.instruction: Make a vertical incision of 1 to 1.5 cm on the left side of the abdomen, cutting first the skin and then the abdominal wall.
Place a piece of gauze wet in sterile PBS close to the incision point.
Expose the pancreas using cotton tips or arruga forceps and place it on the gauze.

steps.title: Perform intrapancreatic injections
steps.instruction: Inject CTb or AAV into the pancreas using a Hamilton syringe.

substeps.instruction: For CTb: Dissolve 100 µg of CTb in 5 µL Sterile PBS; using a 5 µL Hamilton syringe, perform 5 injections of 1 µL each.
For AAV: Inject a total volume between 5 µL and 20 µL, depending on the required concentration.
Spread injections across several places of the pancreas between the head and the tail.
Perform each injection slowly (5-10 seconds) and wait 10-15 seconds before removing the syringe.

steps.title: Close the surgical site
steps.instruction: Return the organ and suture the incision.

substeps.instruction: Place the pancreas back into the abdominal cavity.
Suture the abdominal wall with 2-3 sutures using Vicryl Suture 4-0, 1/2c RB1 (or similar).
Close the skin using an autoclip applier.

steps.title: Post-operative care
steps.instruction: Provide analgesia and monitor the animal's recovery.

substeps.instruction: Inject Buprenorphin (SC, 0.05-0.1 mg/kg) and return the animal to its cage.
Administer analgesia twice a day for the following 2 days.
Monitor animal weight and behavior.

steps.title: Harvest tissues
steps.instruction: Collect the Coeliac ganglia, Nodose ganglia, and Dorsal Root Ganglia based on the agent used.

substeps.instruction: For CTb: Harvest tissues 1 week after injection.
For AAVs: Harvest tissues 3-4 weeks after injection.
